pages.description: The crustaceans, non-native and fierce, are taking over the Gulf of Maine. Could eating them help draw down the population?
pages.text: Invasive green crabs: If you can't beat them, eat them. | National Geographic By Kea Krause Photographs by Brian Skerry Published July 11, 2022 • 12 min read West Bath, Maine — If you close your eyes, a green crab scuttling up your forearm feels more spider than sea creature, its little legs picking their way as if spinning silk. If you open your eyes, you will see the forged work of 200 million years: bumpy carapace, plated apron, calcified pincers. The small crabs are exquisite, seemingly carved from jade. The big ones are monstrous looking. They are nimble and chaotic, and likely under any beach rock in the Gulf of Maine. But here, the European green crab is not native. It is an invader , a species that traveled to the region in the 1800s in the ballast water of trading ships. In the centuries since, the crabs have established a thriving population, feasting on soft-shell clams and blue mussels, overtaking fisheries that have sustained Mainers for centuries. Their monstrous appetites and canny ability to adapt and reproduce have outcompeted any efforts to remove them. Green crabs ( Carcinus maenas ) are an invasive species that first appeared in New England waters in the 1800s, mostly likely arriving in the onboard water of large oceangoing vessels. The species’ population has exploded in recent years due to warming seawater temperatures in the Gulf of Maine. Now, one of the last defenses against these marauding creatures is not to eradicate them, but to eat them . Invasive Species What are Invasive Species? Invasive species are non-native plants, animals and other living organisms that thrive in areas where they don’t naturally live, causing economic or environmental harm, or harm to human, animal or plant health. Invasive species degrade, change or displace native habitats, compete with native wildlife, and are major threats to biodiversity. Learn more about invasive species How You Can Help Invasive Species in Different Regions An invasive species is not native to an ecosystem and likely causes economic or environmental harm, or harm to humans. It is important to note that we are talking about environmental boundaries. A species can be native to one part of the country, and cause damage somewhere else. It is the only program in the United States singularly dedicated to obtaining U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of new medications needed for use in fish culture and fisheries management. Since the late 1990’s, Aquatic Animal Drug Approval Partnership Program has contributed to the majority of the new fish medications approved by the FDA. What are INADS? Investigational New Animal Drugs (INADs) are drugs or medications that are in the approval pipeline but are not yet approved by FDA for use in the United States. In fish science, the term “drug” is used to recognize more than just fish medication, it also includes disinfectants, pesticides, herbicides, and biologics. Participants who enroll in the INAD program are allowed legal access to these drugs under highly controlled and monitored usage. SBICs invest in small business What you can get Check your eligibility Find an investor SBICs invest in small businesses An SBIC is a privately owned company that’s licensed and regulated by the SBA. SBICs invest in small businesses in the form of debt and equity. The SBA doesn’t invest directly into small businesses, but it does provide funding to qualified SBICs with expertise in certain sectors or industries. Those SBICs then use their private funds, along with SBA-guaranteed funding, to invest in small businesses. What you can get SBICs invest in small businesses through debt, equity, or a combination of both. Debt is a loan an SBIC gives to a business, which the business must pay back, along with any interest. Equity is a share of ownership an SBIC gets in a business in exchange for providing funding. Sometimes, an SBIC invests in a business through both debt and equity. Such an investment includes both loans and shares of ownership. A typical SBIC investment is made over a 3-year period. pages.text: Investors sue chip giant Intel after 29% stock plunge Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Investors sue chip giant Intel after 29% stock plunge 7 hours ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Osmond Chia Business reporter Bloomberg via Getty Images Intel boss Tan Lip-Bu Shareholders have sued US chip giant Intel, accusing it of hiding the severity of a slump in personal computer (PC) sales, which they say led to a nearly 29% one-day collapse in the firm's stock. A proposed class action lawsuit in San Jose, California said Intel was too late to alert shareholders about how slowing sales could impact its earnings, allegedly artificially inflating its stock price. Intel shares plunged on 30 October, erasing tens of billions of dollars off its market value the day after it forecasted disappointing revenue in its coming earnings report. The BBC has contacted Intel for comment. The lawsuit, filed by legal firm Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd on behalf of owners of Intel common shares between 23 July and 29 October this year, was filed against the chipmaker, its chief executive Tan Lip-Bu and other company leaders. Intel has been accused of making "materially false and/or misleading" statements that failed to disclose the slowdown in PC sales and the impact of its data centre projects, the complaint said. pages.text: IRS 應用程式 | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content IRS 應用程式 English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In 協助 互動式稅務助手（英文） 工具 文件上傳工具 （英文） 舉報欺詐（英文） 稅務詐騙 身份盜竊 通知和信函 上訴 常見問題解答 （英文） 無障礙 聯絡您當地的國稅局辦事處 聯繫國稅局裡的國際稅務辦公室 稅務主題 其他語言 （英文） 國稅局 ( IRS ) 官方應用程式 直接透過您的行動裝置安全、便捷地使用國稅局服務。隨時隨地查詢退稅狀態、付款並查找實用的稅務資訊。 下載 IRS 應用程式（前稱 IRS2Go ）。該應用程式提供英文版和西班牙文版，可從 Google Play 和 Apple App Store 下載。 在應用程式中取得您的稅務資訊 登入或建立個人帳戶，以便在 IRS 應用程式中存取您的稅務資訊。 付款 繳納應繳餘額或安排付款、查看付款記錄等。 退稅和修改過的報稅表 無論是否登入，均可查詢退稅或修改過的報稅表狀態。 稅務記錄 存取並下載您的稅務記錄，包括稅務謄本和稅務資料申報表文件。 通知和信函 閱讀國稅局發送的有關您稅務事項的正式通知和信函。 個人資料 更新您的電子郵件地址和銀行帳戶資訊。 無需登入也可使用的服務 無需登入，即可在應用程式中使用國稅局服務。 訪客付款 無需登入，即可在 IRS.gov 上查看所有付款選項。直接從您的銀行帳戶免費付款。也可以使用信用卡、簽帳金融卡或 PayPal 、 Venmo 等數位錢包付款，但需支付手續費。 免費報稅 如果您符合資格，可使用免費的報稅選項。您可以透過 IRS 免費報稅（ Free File ）線上報稅，或使用 Free File 可填寫式表格。您還可以在當地的免費報稅服務（ VITA ）站點或透過 AARP 基金會稅務援助（ Tax-Aide ）獲得免費報稅服務。志願者均經過國稅局認證。提供現場和線上服務選項。 更多资源 連結至 IRS.gov 上的熱門主題，例如退稅、稅務記錄、表格及刊物等。您可以透過線上、電話或現場方式聯絡我們。在社交媒體上關注國稅局，獲取最新稅務資訊、提醒和詐騙警示： IRS.gov/socialmedia (英文) 。 無障礙 某些輔助技術可能存在相容性問題。如果您使用螢幕閱讀器、螢幕放大器或語音指令軟體，請參閱 IRS 應用程式無障礙指南 (英文) 以取得協助。 IRS 應用程式快速協助 IRS 應用程式和 IRS2Go 是同一个應用程式嗎？ 是的。應用程式的名稱已變更，並新增了一些功能，但之前的所有服務仍然可以使用。如果您已啟用自動更新，該應用程式將在背景自動更新。如果沒有啟用，您可以在 Apple App Store 或 Google Play 中手動更新該應用程式。 為什麼更改名稱？ IRS2Go 最初是為了方便您透過手機查詢退稅狀態而建立的。 IRS 應用程式提供更全面的行動服務體驗，讓您可以查看欠款餘額、付款以及使用更多功能。 如何確認我下載的是正確的應用程式？ 請使用本頁提供的連結，從 Apple App Store 或 Google Play 下載官方應用程式。請勿透過廣告或未經請求的訊息下載任何應用程式。國稅局絕不會透過簡訊、電子郵件或彈出式訊息索取個人資訊。 如果我發現仿冒應用程式，該怎麼辦？ 請前往 IRS.gov/submitatip 向我們舉報。您也可以舉報稅務騙局和詐欺行為。 如何使用新功能？ 使用 ID.me 登入您的個人帳戶，即可使用 IRS 應用程式中的新功能。系統會將您轉至安全的瀏覽器分頁；透過 ID.me 驗證身份後，系統會將您重新

pages.description: 자원봉사 소득세 지원 프로그램 (VITA) 혹은 연장자 세무 상담 프로그램 (TCE)을 통해 세금 신고 작성 무료 봉사로 지역사회를 도울 수 있습니다.

pages.title: IRS 앱 | Internal Revenue Service
pages.description: IRS 공식 앱을 다운로드하십시오. 잔액을 확인, 세금 납부, 환급 진행 상황 확인 등 다양한 서비스를 이용할 수 있습니다. 이 모든 서비스를 IRS 앱에서 이용하십시오.
pages.text: IRS 앱 | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content IRS 앱 English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In 도움 대화형 세무 지원자 (영어) 도구 문서 업로드 도구 (영어) 사기 신고 (영어) 세금 사기 신원 도용 통지서와 서신 이의 자주 묻는 질문 (영어) 접근성 지역 IRS 사무소에 연락하기 국제 국세청 사무소에 연락하기 과세 대상 언어 선택 (영어) IRS 공식 앱 모바일 기기에서 IRS 서비스를 안전하고 편리하게 이용하십시오. 환급 진행 상황을 확인하고, 세금을 납부하며, 언제 어디서나 유용한 세금 정보를 확인할 수 있습니다. IRS 앱(이전 명칭: IRS2Go )을 다운로드하십시오. Google Play 및 Apple App Store 에서 영어 또는 스페인어로 이용할 수 있습니다. 앱에서 세금 정보를 받으십시오 IRS 앱에서 세금 정보를 확인하려면 로그인하거나 계정을 만드십시오. 납부 미납 세액을 납부하거나 납부 일정 예약하고, 납부 내역 확인 등 다양한 서비스를 이용할 수 있습니다. 환급 및 수정 신고서 로그인하거나 로그인하지 않고도 환급 또는 수정 신고서의 처리 상황을 확인할 수 있습니다. 세금 기록 증명서 및 정보 신고서 문서를 포함한 세금 기록을 열람하고 다운로드할 수 있습니다. 통지서 및 서신 세금과 관련하여 IRS 에서 발송한 공식 통지서 및 서신을 확인할 수 있습니다. 프로필 이메일 주소 및 은행 계좌 정보를 업데이트할 수 있습니다. 로그인하지 않고도 이용 가능 로그인없이 IRS 서비스에 접근하십시오 . 게스트 납부 로그인 없이 IRS.gov 에서 모든 납부 옵션을 확인하십시오. 은행 계좌에서 직접 무료로 납부할 수 있습니다. 수수료를 지불하면 신용카드, 직불카드 또는 PayPal 이나 Venmo 와 같은 디지털 지갑을 이용하여 납부할 수도 있습니다. 무료 세금 신고 자격 요건을 충족하는 경우 무료 세금 신고 옵션을 이용하십시오. IRS Free File 을 통해 온라인으로 신고하거나 Free File Fillable Forms 를 이용하십시오. 지역 Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) 센터 또는 AARP Foundation Tax-Aide 를 통해 무료 세금 신고 지원을 받을 수도 있습니다. 자원봉사자는 IRS 의 인증을 받았습니다. 대면 및 온라인 옵션을 이용할 수 있습니다. 추가 자료 환급, 세금 기록, 서식 및 간행물 등 IRS.gov 의 주요 주제로 이동할 수 있습니다. 온라인, 전화 또는 방문을 통해 IRS 에 문의하십시오. 세금 관련 최신 정보, 알림 및 사기 주의사항은 IRS 소셜 미디어를 팔로우하여 확인하십시오: IRS.gov/socialmedia (영어) . 접근성 일부 보조 기술과의 호환성 문제가 있습니다. 화면 읽기 프로그램, 화면 확대 프로그램 또는 음성 명령 소프트웨어를 사용하는 경우 도움이 필요하면 IRS 앱 접근성 안내(영어) 를 참조하십시오. pages.description: 안전한 이용: 특정 온라인 지원 도구 등록 방법
pages.text: IRS.gov 계정 생성하기 | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content IRS.gov 계정 생성하기 English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In 도움 대화형 세무 지원자 (영어) 도구 문서 업로드 도구 (영어) 사기 신고 (영어) 세금 사기 신원 도용 통지서와 서신 이의 자주 묻는 질문 (영어) 접근성 지역 IRS 사무소에 연락하기 국제 국세청 사무소에 연락하기 과세 대상 언어 선택 (영어) IRS.gov에서 세금 정보를 확인하고 서비스를 이용하기 위해서는 ID.me 계정이 필요합니다. A scanning electron microscopel view of intestinal cells (purple), which are covered with microvilli (pink). In the case of leaky gut syndrome, inflammation increases the permeability of this membrane, allowing unwanted substances to pass from the digestive tract into the bloodstream. ESA / ID&Sense / ONiRiXEL under CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO A decommissioned Russian satellite in low-Earth orbit unexpectedly splintered into more than 100 pieces on Wednesday, temporarily sending International Space Station (ISS) astronauts into precautionary shelters. The satellite, called Resurs-P1, was roughly 220 miles above Earth’s surface when it broke up. While “no immediate threats” were detected, according to a statement from U.S. Space Command, the nine-person crew aboard the ISS—which orbits roughly 250 miles above Earth—briefly sheltered within three docked spacecraft out of an abundance of caution. Two astronauts went into the Boeing Starliner, which is experiencing an extended stay at the station , while the others went into SpaceX’s Crew Dragon and the Russian Soyuz capsules. After about an hour, all were cleared to resume normal operations—which likely involved getting back to bed, as the incident occurred during the astronauts’ typical sleep period . It is currently unclear why the satellite suddenly fragmented. The event, detected by LeoLabs , a U.S.-based space-tracking firm, has so far gone unacknowledged by the Russian space agency, Roscosmos. Scientists speculated a technical malfunction caused the satellite’s explosion or that it collided with another piece of space junk. As he climbed with the friends who had brought him, he began to spot monarchs along the path. Only a few at first. Suddenly, a swarm of butterflies was flying overhead, millions of orange and black wings fluttering against the blue sky beyond. “There were so many that you could feel a slight breeze when they flew over you,” he says. Here are the best places to eat the prized bivalves. The Pacific ‘rock’ oyster and the European native ‘flat’ oyster are the two main types of oysters consumed in the UK. Falmouth Oyster Festival By Davey Brett Published September 2, 2026 This article was produced by National Geographic Traveller (UK). If you ever need an excuse to eat an oyster, Bobby Groves has plenty. The author of Oyster Isles: A Journey Through Britain and Ireland’s Oysters — a book written on a 5,000-mile motorcycle ride across the UK and Ireland charting the oyster industry and its heritage — has more than 20 years’ experience in the industry and makes a compelling argument for their consumption. “I think people want something hyper-local, something [with flavour] that reflects the environment, something that can help fight climate change and is very healthy to eat,” Bobby says. The humble oyster ticks all four boxes, each one filtering surrounding waters, developing its own unique flavour and trapping nitrogen and carbon in its shell. Two main types of oyster are consumed in the UK. The Pacific ‘rock’ oyster and the European native ‘flat’ oyster. Both are bivalve molluscs, but the two differ in origin, taste and shape. pages.text: Itemized deductions, standard deduction | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content Itemized deductions, standard deduction More In Help Interactive Tax Assistant Tools Report fraud Tax scams Identity theft Notices and letters Appeals Frequently asked questions Accessibility Contact your local IRS office Contact an international IRS office Tax topics Other languages Top Frequently Asked Questions for Itemized Deductions, Standard Deduction If I must deduct points over the life of my mortgage, and I have a 30-year mortgage, should I divide the points paid by 30 and enter that amount on Schedule A of Form 1040? Answer: No. While you must deduct the points over the life of the loan ratably (equally), you don't divide the points by 30 years. Instead, you divide the points by the number of payments scheduled over the term of the loan (360 monthly payments in the case of a 30-year mortgage) and deduct points each year according to the number of payments you made in that year (less than twelve payments in some cases). If the loan ends prematurely, for example, because you paid it off or refinanced with a different lender, then the remaining points are deductible in that year. Note: This does not apply to loans refinanced with the same lender. Any deductible points not included on Form 1098 (usually not included on the Form when refinancing) should be entered on Schedule A (Form 1040), Itemized Deductions , line 8c "Points not reported to you on Form 1098." The broadcaster said the proposals would "help to ease some cost pressure" and would allow its English language teams to "work more flexibly". ITV confirmed it was proposing to end its long-running Coast and Country show and weekly arts and entertainment programme Backstage. The changes would not affect the amount of news and current affairs programmes which are broadcast by ITV Wales each week. A spokesperson said the broadcaster had begun consulting with staff after informing most of them about the proposals on Tuesday morning. Coast and Country has run for over a decade and focuses on rural communities, the environment and the Welsh countryside. It has been presented by weather presenter Ruth Dodsworth and Sean Fletcher. BBC Wales understands that the number of producers working at ITV Wales may reduce from six to two as part of the restructure, while efforts to reduce expenditure could mean more programmes are made in the studio rather than on location. pages.text: It’s been called ‘the greatest museum of prehistoric art’—but few tourists know it exists | National Geographic By Henry Wismayer Photographs by Matjaz Krivic Published August 8, 2023 • 12 min read Few people will have heard of the remote Tassili n’Ajjer National Park , even though it is the largest national park in Africa . Located in the southeast corner of Algeria , it comprises the remnants of a vast Precambrian sandstone plateau, extending across 2,780 square miles of the central Sahara, bordering Libya and Niger. The region is a geological wonderland of uncanny rock formations lapped by orange dunes. Eons of erosion have sharpened the sandstone into pinnacles, worn apertures through high escarpments, and sculpted outcrops into surreal and zoomorphic forms. The park is thought to contain over 300 natural arches alone. But these rock forests are only half the story. Tassili’s majesty lies not just in the visual splendor of the rocks, but also what past generations have left on them. Tuarag guide Abdellah Elies explains the legend behind the “Crying Cows,” a celebrated ancient engraving on rock face located between Djanet and Tadrart Rouge. The herd is said to represent the despair of the region’s herders as the “African Humid Period” came to an end and the green Sahara turned to dust. A museum of prehistoric rock art Among Tassili’s most beautiful areas is Tadrart Rouge, accessible via 4x4 tours from the oasis town of Djanet, a two-and-a-half-hour flight from the Algerian capital, Algiers. By Duyen Nguyen | MIT Open Learning About two years ago, a group of medical students at Ege University Faculty of Medicine in Turkey began meeting to study single variable calculus . None of the students had taken a course in this subject before. But with the guidance of lectures, slides, and other freely available resources on MIT OpenCourseWare (OCW), they soon advanced onto multivariable calculus . Then differential equations . Then linear algebra . Today, the students, who call their study group İleri Çalışmalar, or “Advanced Studies,” are paving their own road toward doctoral-level studies — with MIT OCW as their main resource. “Our motivation is to create a theoretical background in order to do research while we’re studying in medical school,” says Yıldırım Adalıoğlu, one of the study group’s co-founders, who explains that MD-PhD programs, which prepare students to become both clinicians and researchers, have only recently become available in Turkey, and are rare. “We didn’t have the chance to do doctoral-level research during medical school. Close j333-1145's Diary osm 极简画法 Posted by j333-1145 on 3 May 2026 in Chinese (China) (‪中文(中国大陆)‬) . 前言 这些随想是在去年年底写的，也许对其他 mapper 有启发，故发布。 以下经验会让画 osm 变得高效、美观、简洁，避免 无线细化 。 正文 osm 本质是抽象、简化的地图，所以画面元素要少、整洁。增加过多的元素会导致地图画面杂乱无章、不美观，而且后期维护也很繁琐。 例：一条公路的两旁有人行道，除非有物理隔离（比如栏杆），否则推荐在道路上加 sidewalk=both ，而不是把两旁的人行道都画出来 要提炼出对象特征，想出表达完整又简练的画面布局，同时不要出现渲染错误。 直线要直、圆形要园、方形要方、弧线要优雅大气。 线条不宜有过多节点，尽量把多余的、又不影响整体的节点删掉 道路、河流、森林等图画，宜大不宜小，宜长不宜短，宜整不宜碎 能不重叠就不重叠。如果一片区域（比如小区、医院、学校等），有明确的边界（比如围墙），最好先画完内部道路、建筑设施，最后再画上土地利用 area=yes 。否则就不要画。 一般使用 iD 编辑器最简单。若想画整齐的方形建筑物建议用 JOSM，并使用 building 插件。 标签方面，非必要不多加。 Discussion Comment from 真中あお on 3 July 2026 at 09:23 提醒自己地图是对现实的抽象，不追求无限细化，这是很有意义的方法论d(`･∀･)b Leave a comment Log in to leave a comment

pages.text: James Bond: Robert Pattinson to replace Daniel Craig as 007 Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Robert Pattinson to replace Daniel Craig as James Bond 1 day ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Steven McIntosh Entertainment reporter Watch: As new Bond, Pattinson takes on one of film's most high-profile roles Robert Pattinson, the British actor known for films such as Twilight and The Batman, has been confirmed as the next actor to play James Bond. The announcement was made by Amazon MGM Studios in a social media post on Monday, with a picture showing Pattinson in character as 007. The 40-year-old becomes the seventh actor to play the famous fictional spy and will star in the 26th Bond movie, due to be released in 2028. In a statement, the London-born actor said: "James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime." The next Bond film will be directed by Denis Villeneuve and written by Steven Knight, but its title and exact release date have not yet been announced. In his statement, Pattinson said he was "deeply grateful" to the film's creative team "for their belief in me". "To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement," he added. "I couldn't be more excited about this partnership and the work ahead with this fantastic team." pages.description: James Botham is accustomed to working away from the spotlight, but his performance could not be denied against New Zealand.
pages.text: James Botham: Wales' unlikely hero in historic win over New Zealand - BBC Sport Image source, Huw Evans Picture Agency Image caption, James Botham was man of the match in Wales' historic win over New Zealand By Gareth Rhys Owen BBC Sport Wales Published 16 November 2026 James Botham lay sprawled on the Principality Stadium turf, pain and exhaustion etched across his face. Whenever the whistle blew, the Wales flanker in the red scrum cap took an age to rise. Precious seconds to recover. Nobody counts tackles when the ball is dead. But when play resumed, he was everywhere. Tackling, scrambling, hitting the deck and springing back up. By the final whistle, Botham had helped Wales beat New Zealand for the first time in 73 years. He was man of the match. And as the celebrations began, the tears flowed. Quite an afternoon for a player accustomed to working away from the spotlight. Keeping a Botham out of the headlines was always going to be difficult. His grandfather, Lord Ian Botham , is one of Britain's great sporting celebrities. Outspoken, charismatic and capable of turning cricket matches almost single-handedly, he is box-office. James is different. His game is built on tackles, chasing, wrestling and relentless graft. Few positions in rugby are less glamorous than blind-side flanker. But on Saturday, Wales' number six was the star of the show. James Briones James Briones is the Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary, Grid Upgrades in the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE)'s Office of Electricity (OE), recognized for his leadership and deep expertise in enhancing the reliability and resilience of the nation’s energy systems. In this role, he leads strategic initiatives that strengthen U.S. energy security, affordability, and dominance through innovative investments and modernization, paving the way for a more reliable and resilient energy future. Prior to rejoining the DOE, James served at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where he led global Security Assurance Programs. James brings over a decade of experience from his previous tenure at DOE, where he led cybersecurity R&D efforts to protect critical energy infrastructure. He also spent nine years at the U.S. Air Force’s Space and Missile Systems Center, advancing national defense technologies. He holds degrees in electrical engineering, information systems management, and an MBA, and is certified as a CISSP and GIAC professional. Articles by James Briones

James Danly Deputy Secretary of Energy James P. Danly was sworn in as Deputy Secretary on June 9, 2025. Before arriving at the Department, Deputy Secretary Danly was a partner and the Energy Regulatory Group leader at Skadden in Washington, D.C. This followed his service at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, first as the Commission’s general counsel then as the commissioner and chairman. Deputy Secretary Danly was an officer in the United States Army. He served two tours in Iraq, receiving a Bronze Star and a Purple Heart. A graduate of Yale University, Deputy Secretary Danly earned his J.D. from Vanderbilt University Law School. He clerked for Judge Danny J. Boggs of the Sixth Circuit. Download Official Photo
